Compute PCA and UMAP from a genotype matrix

Source: R/pop_structure.R
pop_structure.Rd

Mean-imputes missing genotypes, runs PCA (stats::prcomp()) and, optionally, a UMAP embedding (uwot) with PCA initialisation. Returns a pop_structure object the plot_*() functions read.

Usage

pop_structure(
  geno,
  samples = NULL,
  meta = NULL,
  n_pcs = 50,
  umap = TRUE,
  umap_pca = 30,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  seed = 42
)

Arguments

geno

A genotype matrix (samples x SNPs, 0/1/2, NA allowed) or the list returned by run_ld_prune().

samples

Sample ids (defaults to the genotype list's sample.id, or matrix row names).

meta

Optional per-sample metadata: a data frame with a sample column (plus e.g. region, country) used for colouring.

n_pcs

Number of PCs to summarise (variance explained).

umap

Compute a UMAP embedding.

umap_pca, n_neighbors, min_dist

UMAP parameters (defaults 30 / 15 / 0.1); n_neighbors is clamped to the sample count.

seed

Random seed for UMAP.

Value

A pop_structure object (a list with samples, pca scores, pca_var, umap, meta).
